description: The main window may open a file picker, move or resize its native window, and call SimpleMark's audited note and workspace commands — including reading a data file a chart names, resolved against the open note by the same rules a Markdown link obeys, and — only when the user has explicitly clicked "Fix it" on a broken diagram with an API key configured in Settings — an authenticated chat-completion request to the endpoint that key belongs to. No general filesystem, shell, or unscoped network permission is granted: every other capability goes through this crate's narrow commands, and network access is limited to that one explicit, user-initiated, user-configured call and to downloading the images a pasted article references, which is bounded to http and https, to public addresses, to image responses, and to a size ceiling (ADR-0008).
